about.intro: Developer and Consultant focused on Microsoft Cloud Technologies, with a global perspective. My work has reached organizations across Brazil, China, Uruguay, the United States, Europe and global enterprises. I am currently a fellow student at Goldsmiths, University of London. Quick to build deep and broad knowledge, with an adaptable, diverse skillset that has driven success and failures in multiple operating environments.
about.story: Beyond my professional role, I enjoy exploring projects that combine technology, creativity and entrepreneurship. I am driven by curiosity and continuous learning, always seeking projects that align with my values, technical expertise and long-term aspirations.

description: Architected and delivered an end-to-end event order digitization solution for EU-OSHA using Power Apps, Power Automate, .NET upgrade, JavaScript and c# plugins, improving workflow automation, governance, financial visibility and stakeholder engagement.

Managed ALM and production deployments for large Power Platform solutions across multiple international projects, maintaining Azure DevOps pipelines with powershell, resolving solution dependencies and coordinating complex releases into production.
Developed AI-enabled solutions, including a Power Automate language translator using AI prompts.

AI-Assisted Development & Agentic Workflows: Use of Visual Studio Code agents to develop reusable skills and instructions with plugins focused on Power Platform while expanding expertise in Azure AI Foundry and the Microsoft AI stack.

experience.company: Pentare Consulting Technology, Ribeirão Preto, Brazil (remote)
experience.role: Deployment and Project Consultant - Power Platform Developer
description: Developed and deployed Microsoft Power Platform solutions using C# plugins (PRT), PCFs, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, REST APIs and custom connectors, extending CRM capabilities.
Delivered integrations across enterprise platforms, including Dataverse, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, ServiceNow and IBM Maximo.
Led feasibility analysis, documentation and implementation of CRM improvements, including quotation processes, payment follow-ups, price lists and custom Power Apps solution packages.

experience.company: Tero by Nortal, Montevideo, Uruguay (remote) * Clients across U.S
description: Implemented Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices and Dataverse administration.

Led end-to-end delivery across Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Power Pages and Power Automate, covering requirements analysis, data modelling, integrations, testing and go-live for clients across the United States.

Extended Power Platform solutions through custom development and integrations, translating business requirements into scalable applications and supporting project governance from implementation through production deployment.
Built and deployed custom event pages for Think Summit 2021 across 14 international locales using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and IBM Carbon Components.
Developed and maintained low-code web pages (under ibm.com) using Drupal, Markdown and IBM Content Creator Tool.
Collaborated on end-to-end web development and deployment workflows using Git Workflows and GitHub, delivering localized, responsive event experiences across multiple international markets.

experience.company: S4R Technology, São Paulo, Brazil – Chinese client (remote)
description: Migrated InfoPath forms to Power Apps and automated approval workflows with Power Automate (Chinese client).
Trained key users on Power Apps/Power Automate and supported international teams with cloud infrastructure, SharePoint, Power BI and Microsoft 365 solutions.
Built and customized SharePoint solutions for document management, including version-controlled libraries, automated document approvals, email notifications and JSON-based list customizations.
Automated supply chain processes and approval workflows using SharePoint, InfoPath and Nintex.
Delivered SharePoint solutions and administration support across multiple projects including custom forms, lists, views, intranet pages, business-data management and Office 365 migration support.

Identified opportunities to apply Power Platform and Azure AI to business processes contributing to innovation initiatives through Azure Cognitive Services research, technical documentation, requirements gathering, and key-user training.
